==Notes==
*This form uses female monk animations, regardless of your character's gender or profession.
*All [[action]]s (including skill activations, attacks, and movement) will be [[cancel]]led when this form ends.
*The hex removal will take place after the Dervish attack skill has been used. Skills like [[Empathy]] will still deal damage for this attack.
*The [[hero]] [[M.O.X.]] has a unique skin for this form.
